correctness.rationale: The LCF [5,7,-7,7,-7,-5]^3 yields a cubic Pappus graph with 18 vertices and 27 edges; every vertex subset has induced components of order <=2 iff maximum induced degree <=1. An independently written generic integer Morse checker enumerated all 262144 possible masks, obtaining 20652 augmented faces and the claimed f-vector, reconstructed all 10321 successive toggles, checked all 120240 Hasse incidences with a complete acyclic topological order, and computed the exact signed 9x1 critical C6->C5 boundary as nine zeros. One augmented empty/vertex pair removes as a basepoint pair, leaving one vertex, nine 5-cells, one 6-cell. Since pi5(vee^9 S5)=H5=Z9, the zero integral degree column makes the 6-attachment nullhomotopic. This is a complete finite proof for this labeled graph and not an infinite-family extrapolation.

value.rationale: The Pappus (9_3) Levi graph is a canonical symmetric cubic incidence graph and Ind_2 is the natural dissociation/degree-one induced-subgraph complex. Its mixed 5/6-dimensional integral homotopy type is not supplied by its ordinary matching or independence topology or by an extremal dissociation number. The explicit non-pure, high-dimensional face collapse and zero integral attaching map give an independently reusable exact invariant for work on higher independence complexes of incidence graphs; one finite graph, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
